title: Fair line, market line and the difference, as separate columns

column_notes.fair_side: Our number, home convention (negative = home favoured). Derived.
column_notes.market_side: The publisher's number, converted to the same convention.
column_notes.fair_total: Our number for the combined score.
column_notes.ml_prob_diff_pts: our home-win probability minus the market-implied one, in percentage points. The market figure still contains the vig, so a zero here would mean we are slightly *behind* the market.
column_notes.market_book_named: false on every row: the source names no book (defect P-04).
